title: UISD Early Birds meet 'El Torito': literature, Mexican cinema and a life of perseverance
excerpt: Alexander and United high school students in the UTSA Early Birds program met Emilio Girón Fernández de Jáuregui, the child actor known as 'El Torito' in the classic Mexican film Ustedes los ricos, according to United ISD.
content:
Alexander and United high school students in the University of Texas at San Antonio Early Birds program met the actor behind one of Mexican cinema's most memorable child roles, according to United ISD.

Emilio Girón Fernández de Jáuregui, famously known as “El Torito” in the classic 1984 Mexican film Ustedes los ricos, starring Pedro Infante, joined Alexander High School Bulldogs in person and United High School Longhorns virtually via Google Meet, the district said.

The visit grew out of a collaborative lesson led by Alexander Spanish Department Chairperson Sylvia Vargas, adjunct professor Guadalupe Aguiar and United High School educator Viridiana Rodriguez. Students have been studying the connections between Juan Rulfo's short story “Es que somos muy pobres” and classic Mexican cinema, examining how poverty, loss, family bonds and social inequality shape characters' lives, according to United ISD.

Girón Fernández de Jáuregui was just 13 months old when he appeared alongside Pedro Infante, the district said. His own life, United ISD reported, became a story of resilience: after losing both parents during childhood, he settled in Nuevo Laredo with an uncle, pursued his education, met his future wife and built a career in business. A graduate of the Universidad Autónoma de Tamaulipas in Nuevo Laredo with a background in accounting and auditing, he has also helped preserve Mexican cultural heritage by organizing tributes to Pedro Infante and was nominated in 2025 for Tamaulipas' Medalla al Mérito Luis García Arellano, according to the district.

United ISD thanked Girón Fernández de Jáuregui for sharing the learning opportunity, along with Vargas, Aguiar and Rodriguez, and Lorena Girón, a UISD diagnostician and Girón's daughter, who served as liaison for the project.

Sources:

  • United Independent School District, “From the Silver Screen to the Classroom: AHS Early Birds Connect Literature, Film, and Resilience,” Oct. 29, 2026
